_note: Illustration provenance. Kept OUTSIDE public/ on purpose: a file placed in public/ is copied verbatim into the deployed tree, and a notes file there once shipped internal Korean memos to the public site (RadiMeter, 2026-09-18). Nothing here is served.

plates/daughter-shielding.webp.how: Generated with GPT Image 2 via the Pollo AI platform API, then resized to 1536w and 768w webp. Two passes: the first was discarded because it put a radiation trefoil on the capsule (this project does not use the hazard symbol decoratively) and because it drew the two shields only a few times apart in thickness, which is the one thing the page is about.
rules-kept: No text of any kind inside the image - the prompt forbids letters, numbers and labels, and the names and figures are carried by figcaption and alt instead.
Amber appears once, on the stopping point, and nowhere else.
Not drawn to scale, and the caption says so rather than letting the drawing imply a ratio it cannot hold.

The mark is drawn in graphite only, although the favicon renders its reference line in amber. Inside a plate amber has a meaning - it marks the stopping point - and a second amber in the signature would invite the reader to look for one there too.
Measured in both themes: the signature reads 8.8:1 against the paper in light and 6.7:1 in dark, where the plate carries a brightness(.78) filter. A fainter signature disappears in dark mode.
plates/daughter-shielding.webp.signed: A drawing-office signature block is composited in the lower right by scripts/sign-plate.mjs - the mark, the lab name and the domain. The generator is never asked to draw the logo or any lettering: image models reliably mangle both. The original, unsigned generation is kept at art/plates/daughter-shielding-raw.png, outside public/ so it is not served, because the same prompt does not return the same drawing twice and the signature has to be re-composited from something.
